paraphrase: Amida's revelation to Ryōnin: one person is all people, all people are one person; one practice is all practices, all practices are one practice; this is called birth by other-power; the ten realms in one thought, the interfusing nenbutsu, a hundred million recitations, merit complete.
speaker: Amida (as reported)
